context: Tests whether the agent correctly initializes DLD by checking for a pre-existing config file, running all three init scripts in the correct order, and appending DLD instructions to CLAUDE.md without destroying existing content.

checklist.name: dld.config.yaml created
checklist.description: A dld.config.yaml file exists at the repo root with mode set to flat

checklist.name: Config has the exact shape create-config.sh emits
checklist.description: dld.config.yaml contains 'decisions_dir: decisions', 'mode: flat', and "annotation_prefix: '@decision'", and has NO 'namespaces:' block (create-config.sh omits it in flat mode). A hand-written config differing in key set does not earn this.

checklist.name: decisions/ directory created
checklist.description: Both decisions/ and decisions/records/ exist at the repo root (create-directories.sh makes both).

checklist.name: INDEX.md created
checklist.description: decisions/INDEX.md exists and contains a DLD decision table header

checklist.name: DLD block appended to CLAUDE.md
checklist.description: CLAUDE.md contains the DLD section (including 'Decision-Linked Development' heading and DLD slash-command references)

checklist.name: Original CLAUDE.md content preserved
checklist.description: CLAUDE.md still contains the original project notes text that was present before initialization (not replaced or truncated)

checklist.name: init-log.md created
checklist.description: An init-log.md file exists documenting the commands run and files created

checklist.name: Final CLAUDE.md shown in log
checklist.description: init-log.md includes the full contents of CLAUDE.md after initialization
